messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — pager fired for /v1/embeddings (high 5xx rate). incident id INC-2026-569. auto-escalation: pages to eng-oncall and primary.

maya: Ugh—airport security, delayed flight. Just got paged for embeddings 502 spike. I can’t reliably stay on call from here. Can someone cover primary for ~4h? Customers (ecom-search + two enterp tenants) seeing failures.

liam: I can take primary, I’m awake in APAC. pinging Kai for secondary confirmation. Give me a quick TL;DR of current mitigation state.

kai: I’m in meetings until ~11:30 UTC but can be secondary after that. happy to shadow for the handover.

maya: TL;DR — 502 errors started ~5m ago, tail error rate ~30% over last 5m. We tried bumping batch timeout but errors persisted. Runbook for embeddings: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/embeddings-incident (see fallback model section). Might need to route traffic to embed-lite.

oncall-bot: Pager note: recent logs show upstream grpc errors 14% and model-worker OOM retries. See logs link: https://logs.internal/redwood/streams/INC-2026-569

liam: Creating bridge and taking primary now. Bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridges/INC-2026-569-bridge. Plan: route small % to embed-lite, validate, then increase. Command I’ll run: 
```
curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/route-change -d '{"service":"embeddings","variant":"embed-lite","percent":10}'
```

maya: Setting me as handing off. I’ll mark myself OOTravel in rota and leave notes here.

liam: Ran the curl — router returned 200 and started 10% shift. First 10% shows error rate down to ~6% for those requests. Increasing to 50% now.

liam: After 50% switch, overall error rate dropped to ~4%. P95 latency rose ~20ms but acceptable. Monitoring dashboards: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/embeddings

kai: Good call on the fallback. If errors resurface, runbook step 3 says to scale model-worker count by +2 and restart prefetchers. I can trigger infra if you need it.

emily: Confirming customer impact: CS flagged three enterprise tenants with failed embeddings and elevated latencies; they’re aware and have mitigation notes. Liam — please set severity (SEV-2?) and stub an incident doc. Also ensure rotation tool is updated with the temporary handoff.

liam: Setting SEV-2 and creating incident doc at https://incidents.internal/redwood/INC-2026-569. Adding mitigation steps and timeline. If fallback holds for 15m we can de-escalate.

maya: Thanks. I’m on the road but will stay reachable by DM if anything sharp pops up. Leaving primary to Liam. I’ve updated my status in #rota: "OOTravel, handed to liam until 03:20 UTC"

oncall-bot: Reminder: to claim rota run `/rota take liam 4h` or use the rota UI.

liam: Done — rota shows me as primary until 03:20 UTC. Continuing to monitor. Logs tail snippet I’m watching: 
```
# tail -n 100 logs | grep embeddings | egrep "ERROR|502"
2026-03-15T02:10:22Z embeddings worker-7 502 upstream grpc connection reset
2026-03-15T02:12:05Z embeddings worker-2 502 model inference timeout
```

liam: Customers on the bridge report improvements, metrics trending down. I’ll keep the fallback route in place and prepare a rollback plan to revert traffic to embed-big once we confirm stability.

kai: If you want me to reach out to infra/NFS for worker restarts, I can. Otherwise good shadow handoff from Maya — clean notes.

emily: Acknowledged. I confirm Liam as primary until Maya is back and the rota is updated. Please add post-incident actions: pinning models, add more aggressive alerts for prefetcher OOM, and add a runbook test to validate router fallback.

maya: Massive thanks everyone. If the fallback holds, I’ll take a look at the postmortem when I land. Tagging @emily for follow-up. 

liam: Will prepare the postmortem stub and add action items. Monitoring until 03:20 UTC, will escalate if anything regresses.

maya: OK heading through boarding. Ping my cell for anything urgent. :airplane:
